description: Add an instance of another scene (.tscn) as a child node. This is how you compose scenes from reusable parts (like prefabs). The instance maintains a live reference to the source scene. Use this instead of add_node when you want to reuse an existing scene.

instance_path.description: Path to the .tscn scene to instance (the child/prefab scene)

node_name.description: Optional name for the instance. If omitted, uses the instanced scene's root node name.

parent_path.description: Path to parent node within the scene (. for root, or relative path like Level/Enemies)

properties.description: Optional property overrides on the instance root (e.g., {position: {type: "Vector3", x: 5, y: 0, z: 10}})

scene_path.description: Path to the scene file being edited (the parent scene)

name: instance_scene
